summary.text: Johanna López represents District 43 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which López was first elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Before that, López served as a member of the Orange County School District school board, District 2, from 2018 to 2022.
López lives in Orlando, was born in Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, moved to Florida in 1998, and studied Hispanic studies at the Universidad de Puerto Rico.
